question: Take the genes with region-enriched RNA expression in cerebellum and those region-enriched in cerebral cortex. Give the size of each set. Compute the Spearman correlation of nTPM across all brain regions between the two sets' mean profiles. Draw a heatmap of the twenty cerebellum-enriched genes with the highest cerebellum nTPM across all brain regions. Provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Brain region\", COUNT(*) n FROM rna_brain_region_hpa GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA brain regional specificity\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA brain regional distribution\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene, \"RNA brain regional specificity\", \"RNA brain regional distribution\", \"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA brain regional specificity\"='Region enriched' LIMIT 10"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH pa AS (SELECT Gene, lower(split_part(\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\", ':', 1)) region, TRY_CAST(trim(split_part(\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\", ':', 2)) AS DOUBLE) spec FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA brain regional specificity\"='Region enriched'), sets AS (SELECT 'cerebellum' setname, Gene FROM pa WHERE region='cerebellum' UNION ALL SELECT 'cerebral cortex',Gene FROM pa WHERE region='cerebral cortex'), prof AS (SELECT s.setname, r.\"Brain region\", avg(TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE)) mean_ntpm FROM sets s JOIN rna_brain_region_hpa r ON r.Gene=s.Gene GROUP BY 1,2), ranked AS (SELECT *, rank() over(partition by setname order by mean_ntpm) rk FROM prof) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sets WHERE setname='cerebellum') cerebellum_set_size, (SELECT count(*) FROM sets WHERE setname='cerebral cortex') cortex_set_size, corr(CASE WHEN setname='cerebellum' THEN rk END, CASE WHEN setname='cerebral cortex' THEN rk END) FROM ranked GROUP BY \"Brain region\""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH pa AS (SELECT Gene, lower(split_part(\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\", ':', 1)) region FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA brain regional specificity\"='Region enriched'), prof AS (SELECT r.\"Brain region\" br, avg(CASE WHEN p.region='cerebellum' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) cb, avg(CASE WHEN p.region='cerebral cortex' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) cc FROM rna_brain_region_hpa r JOIN pa p ON r.Gene=p.Gene GROUP BY 1), rr AS (SELECT *, rank() over(order by cb) rb, rank() over(order by cc) rc FROM prof) SELECT corr(rb,rc) spearman FROM rr WHERE cb IS NOT NULL AND cc IS NOT NULL"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH pa AS (SELECT Gene, lower(split_part(\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\", ':', 1)) region FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA brain regional specificity\"='Region enriched' AND lower(split_part(\"RNA brain regional specific nTPM\", ':', 1))='cerebellum'), top AS (SELECT p.Gene, max(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='cerebellum' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END) cb FROM pa p JOIN rna_brain_region_hpa r ON r.Gene=p.Gene GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cb DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT t.Gene, round(t.cb,1) cerebellum, round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='cerebral cortex' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) \"cerebral cortex\", round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='hippocampal formation' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) \"hippocampal formation\", round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='amygdala' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) amygdala, round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='basal ganglia' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) \"basal ganglia\", round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='choroid plexus' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) \"choroid plexus\", round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='hypothalamus' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) hypothalamus, round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='medulla oblongata' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) \"medulla oblongata\", round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='midbrain' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) midbrain, round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='pons' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) pons, round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='spinal cord' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) \"spinal cord\", round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='thalamus' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) thalamus, round(avg(CASE WHEN r.\"Brain region\"='white matter' THEN TRY_CAST(r.nTPM AS DOUBLE) END),1) \"white matter\" FROM top t JOIN rna_brain_region_hpa r ON r.Gene=t.Gene GROUP BY t.Gene,t.cb ORDER BY t.cb DESC"}
